remarks.para: The snapshot entry carries resolved membership facts needed for auditing.

property.name: AssertionSummaries
property.summary: Assertion summaries projected from the resolved access-key claims.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Audience claims carried by the membership.

property.name: Expired
property.summary: True when the membership is expired at the evaluation instant used to build the snapshot.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Manifest hash bound into the membership.

property.name: NotAfter
property.summary: Membership expiration instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Scope claims carried by the membership.

method.name: Allows
method.summary: Determine whether the snapshot entry grants a protected operation.
method.returns: True if the operation is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: Copy
method.summary: Create a defensive copy of the snapshot entry.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create an audit-safe snapshot entry from resolved access-key claims.
